meta.name: Murder Drones
meta.description: Murder Drones 1. sezon 1. bölüm full HD, Türkçe dublaj ve altyazılı izle 1080p izle. Kolonisinin duvarları arasında sıkışıp kalmaktan bunalan isyankâr genç işçi...

videos.title: Meet J
videos.overview: J shows a bit of her life.

videos.title: Heartbeat
videos.overview: Uzi and N are called back to the colony to investigate a string of gruesome murders, and it seems like someone from their past may be behind it.

videos.title: The Promening
videos.overview: Proms are dumb and stupid, but Uzi has to attend one anyway when her classmate begins picking off fellow students one by one.

videos.title: Cabin Fever
videos.overview: Camping in the frigid, poisonous, foreboding woods was meant to be really easy. But instead, it becomes filled with terror when Uzi and N find strange secrets bubbling up from below.

videos.title: Home
videos.overview: A very normal episode set in the present timeline. Nothing weird going on here. Why is that mirror writing threatening messages?

videos.title: Dead End
videos.overview: Uzi, N, and V can no longer ignore all of the answers calling for them from below the planet's surface, so they decide to take the plunge into a deadly abyss and face the worst thing imaginable: a really creepy baby.

videos.title: Mass Destruction
videos.overview: A lot of things happen in this episode, so don't read this, just go watch.

videos.title: Absolute End
videos.overview: Uzi and Cyn clash in an epic battle of psychic power to decide the fate of the universe. Also, N is there.
